summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration_8 polish. Both issues from iteration_7 are RESOLVED. (1) nav-utility strip: at scrollY=0 -> bounding-box height=36px, opacity=1, transform=none. At scrollY=600 -> height collapses to ~1px, opacity=0, transform=translateY(-1px) (via existing h-0 -translate-y-full opacity-0 classes — behaves as required even though the review-request wording said max-h-0/opacity-0). (2) Zero 'An empty string was passed to the src attribute' console warnings on initial load OR after scrolling to #insights; zero elements with empty src detected in DOM. Regression: hero-rotator + hero-dashboard-mock render, nav-scroll-progress present, insights-eyebrow shows 'Insights · 9 notes' with 5 cards initially, Load More increments 5->8, ROI submit renders KPIs money=35%, manpower=55% (~4.5 FTE), time=35% (~260 hrs/wk), and cumulative-saving polyline count=1 inside roi-result.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: Navbar.jsx still uses `h-0 -translate-y-full opacity-0` (not `max-h-0 opacity-0` as review-request wording described). The behavior is functionally correct (utility strip hides fully on scroll), so this is only a doc/PR-description drift, not a bug. Fine to keep as-is.

Insights.jsx still renders unconditionally (no conditional placeholder div per review-request). However, all API + FALLBACK insights currently have non-empty image_url values, so no empty-src warnings surface. If image_url can ever be empty in future data, add: `{p.image_url ? :
}` to be defensive.
